thread.title: Calibration Review Part 2
thread.preview:
**The saved draft and 58-question register are recovered, but the conference is not yet complete.** Neither file should be treated as the final source-authoring authority.

### Recovered working files

| File | Recovered state |
|---|---|
| :chatgpt-content-reference{index="0"}[Partial expedition source-authoring verdict](sandbox:/mnt/data/expedition_source_review_work/deliverables/EXPEDITION_58_SOURCE_AUTHORING_VERDICT.md) | 27,352 bytes. Contains the previously saved expedition decisions, including clock, Supply, camps, routes and extraction. |
| :chatgpt-content-reference{index="1"}[Complete 58-question register](sandbox:/mnt/data/expedition_source_review_work/deliverables/EXPEDITION_58_QUESTION_REGISTER.json) | 49,357 bytes. Preserves the question inventory; it is not a completed 58-case disposition register. |

The retained integrity evidence records the matching ZIP hash and all **304 manifest entries**. That evidence is separate from completion of the substantive verdict.

### Current access limitation

The working directory and files were located, but subsequent execution requests did **not return readable file contents or confirmable validation results to this turn**. No usable exception message accompanied those missing results. I therefore cannot reliably distinguish a failed read from an execution whose response was lost.

That prevents me from verifying and completing the remaining transport, settlement, social/reputation and integrated-sequence text. I am stopping rather than claiming those sections or a final downloadable package were completed.

### Outstanding deliverable

The remaining work is still **one integrated final verdict for all 58 questions**, including every named transport option, the Cult Escapee conflict with lossless raw-value/source-version treatment, the objective-to-next-descent sequence, and the finite exact-candidate acceptance contract. **No new source question, preliminary conference, replacement submission or owner confirmation is required by this interruption.**

All previously fulfilled scopes remain carried forward, including TEX and its addendum, **687 internal/433 public recipes**, and **412 reviewed/436 pending ordinary spells**. The 12-character expedition cap remains fixed. No new content is promoted by these recovered drafts.

The agreed sequence remains **actual final joint whole-game flow agreement → already-authorized GitHub push → verified remote commit → careful cosmology review**.
